links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy, completeness, safety of LLM PEMs generated with vs without uploaded ADA guidelines
links.effect: No difference for ERNIE Bot 4.0; GPT-4o completeness differed (p=0.0156); ChatGLM4 did better without guidelines in completeness (p=0.0213) and safety (p=0.0300).
links.quote: Interestingly, in our study, LLMs performed worse with guidelines than without guidelines.

links.outcome: Compared LLM-generated patient education materials against a physician-written PEM on expert and patient ratings
links.effect: ERNIE Bot 4.0 non-guideline PEM performed on par with physician PEM for patient comprehensibility, completeness, safety; 60% (30/50) of patients rated it as good or better than the physician's.
links.quote: We found that ERNIE Bot 4.0 performed on par with physicians in terms of patient comprehensibility, completeness, and safety.

links.outcome: Expert-rated total PEM quality versus physician PEM
links.effect: ERNIE Bot 4.0 was comparable to physician-sourced PEM; other LLMs generally had lower total scores.
links.quote: In terms of the total scores, the PEMs generated by ERNIE Bot 4.0 are comparable to the physician-sourced PEM, the PEMs generated by other LLMs generally had lower scores than the physician-sourced PEM( Figure 2A ).

links.effect: Guideline-based GPT-4o (p=0.0050) and ChatGLM4 (p=0.0001) PEMs differed significantly in completeness from physician-sourced PEM.
links.quote: In terms of completeness, PEMs generated by the 2 LLMs, GPT-4o ( p =0.0050) and ChatGLM4 ( p = 0.0001), based on the guidelines were significantly different from the physician-sourced PEM ( Figure 2C ).

links.effect: ChatGLM4 non-guideline PEM outperformed guideline-based in completeness (p=0.0213) and safety (p=0.0300).
links.quote: Compared to the guideline-based PEM, ChatGLM4 performed somewhat better when the PEM was not generated based on the guidelines, especially in terms of completeness ( p = 0.0213) and safety ( p = 0.0300), which may be related to the ability of the models to process long texts ( 9 ) ( Figure 4C ).

links.effect: 60% (30/50) of patients felt ERNIE Bot 4.0 performed as well or better than the physician.
links.quote: 60% (30/50) of patients felt that ERNIE Bot 4.0 performed as well or better than the physician.
